features.title.message: A super-stable software, designed for performance & security

features.openSourceCode.message: Open-Source Code, reviewed by the community

gladysPlusPage.v2.eu.subtitle.message: The infrastructure that powers Gladys Plus runs primarily in European data centers, and your data is always end-to-end encrypted.

gladysPlusPage.v2.eu.ai.text.message: The Open-Weight AI models used by Gladys Plus are hosted by Scaleway in European data centers. AI inference stays within the EU.

gladysPlusPage.v2.eu.infra.text.message: The Gladys Plus infrastructure (API, backups, relays) runs in European data centers, operated under GDPR.

gladysPlusPage.v2.eu.e2e.text.message: Even if our servers were compromised, your data stays safe: your commands and backups are end-to-end encrypted with keys that only your local Gladys instance owns.

gladysPlusPage.v2.finalCta.text.message: One month free trial, no credit card required, no commitment. Cancel anytime.

gladysPlusPage.v2.founder.text.message: I created Gladys Assistant in 2013 and build Gladys Plus myself. No investors, no ads. Just an indie open-source project funded by people who use it every day. Questions? I read every message.

gladysPlusPage.v2.howItWorks.subtitle.message: Three steps to unlock Gladys Plus on your existing instance.

gladysPlusPage.v2.compare.subtitle.message: Nabu Casa is the official Home Assistant Cloud, made by the team driving Home Assistant. It's a great product. Here's how Gladys Plus compares, without cherry-picking.

gladysPlusPage.v2.compare.funds.nc.message: Open Home Foundation (HA, ESPHome, Z-Wave JS)

gladysPlusPage.v2.compare.honest.nc.message: Nabu Casa is excellent if you're on Home Assistant. They include cloud backups, a privacy-focused local voice assistant (Nabu), and WebRTC for cameras at €7.50/month. They also fund a whole ecosystem (HA, ESPHome, Z-Wave JS) via the Open Home Foundation.

gladysPlusPage.v2.compare.honest.gladys.message: Gladys Plus only makes sense if you actually use Gladys Assistant. Plus Lite is cheaper than Nabu Casa for the basics. Plus is more expensive but adds an open REST API, Open-Weight AI models, MCP, French integrations like Enedis, and direct contact with the maker (in French if you want). It's an indie project funded by you alone, with no investors and no foundation.

gladysPlusPage.v2.offlineAlert.title.message: Get an email when your Gladys goes down

gladysPlusPage.v2.offlineAlert.subtitle.message: Power cut, internet box down, dead SD card, a Docker update gone wrong: when your instance stays unreachable, Gladys Plus emails you. You find out the same day, not in the evening when you get home.

gladysPlusPage.v2.offlineAlert.screensho.message: The Gladys Plus setting to get an email when Gladys goes offline, with the delay to choose

gladysPlusPage.v2.offlineAlert.plans.message: Included in both plans, Lite and Plus · No credit card required

gladysPlusPage.v2.personas.subtitle.message: Gladys Plus is built for three kinds of users, and you probably recognize yourself in one of them.

gladysPlusPage.v2.personas.mobile.title.message: You want to access Gladys from anywhere

gladysPlusPage.v2.personas.mobile.text.message: Reach your home automation from anywhere in the world, securely, without opening any port or renewing certificates. Everything is end-to-end encrypted.

gladysPlusPage.v2.personas.power.text.message: Enedis to track your electricity usage, Open-Weight AI models to talk to your home, remote camera streaming, MCP server to plug your favorite AIs into your home automation.

gladysPlusPage.v2.personas.support.title.message: You want to support the project

gladysPlusPage.v2.personas.support.text.message: Gladys is free and open-source forever. Gladys Plus is what lets me work on it full-time. Every subscription truly counts.
